newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume slumps as prices rise.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume slumps as prices rise.

text.p: Traded volume on the Istanbul gold exchange slumped to 180 kilos on Wednesday from Tuesday's 900 kilos as world gold prices rose, sidelining traders not expecting the higher prices to last, dealers said.
There was no trading in dollar terms on Wednesday after gold closed at $343.80 an ounce on Tuesday. Gold firmed in lira terms to 1,555,900 lira per gram from 1,555,000 lira on Tuesday.

"Gold was firmer on the main European markets, but nobody on the exchange really expects this rise to last. For this reason, there wasn't much interest in gold today, but we expect demand to pick up again later in the week," one dealer said.
All of the day's 180 kilos trade took place in the morning session and was conducted in lira terms.
